q: Which of the following is an example of an energy source obtained from Earth's internal heat?
exp: Geothermal energy uses heat from within Earth, e.g. hot springs and steam.

q: Which of the following is the process used in a nuclear power plant to generate energy?
exp: Nuclear reactors split heavy nuclei such as uranium-235 to release energy.

q: Compressed Natural Gas (CNG) used as a cleaner vehicle fuel is mainly composed of
exp: CNG is mostly methane, burning with lower particulate emissions than petrol or diesel.

q: The Environment Impact Assessment (EIA) is carried out
options: Before starting a development project to assess its likely environmental effects
exp: EIA is a pre-project study to predict and mitigate environmental impacts.

q: Joint Forest Management in India involves
options: Local communities and the forest department sharing management and benefits
exp: JFM (1990) involves village committees in protecting forests in return for usufruct benefits.

q: The Kanwar Lake (Kabartal) wetland, a Ramsar site, is located in which Bihar district?
exp: Kabartal (Kanwar Jheel) in Begusarai was designated a Ramsar site in 2020.

q: The soil conservation method of ploughing along the contour lines of a slope helps to
options: Reduce soil erosion by slowing run-off
exp: Contour ploughing creates barriers to run-off, retaining water and soil.

q: Which of the following is a perpetual (inexhaustible) resource?
exp: Solar energy is available continuously and is not depleted by use; groundwater, forests and soil are renewable only if managed.

q: Which of the following is NOT a method of in-situ conservation?
exp: A seed bank stores seeds outside the natural habitat and is therefore ex-situ.

q: A major difference between a National Park and a Wildlife Sanctuary is that in a National Park
options: Private ownership of land is encouraged
Human activities such as grazing and forestry are not permitted
exp: National parks have stricter protection with no grazing or collection of forest produce.

q: The Earth Summit held at Rio de Janeiro in 1992 resulted in which of the following?
options: Convention on Biological Diversity and Agenda 21
exp: The 1992 UN Conference on Environment and Development opened CBD and UNFCCC for signature and adopted Agenda 21.

q: The Intergovernmental Panel on Climate Change (IPCC) was set up by
exp: IPCC was established in 1988 by the United Nations Environment Programme and World Meteorological Organization.

q: Landslides in hilly areas are mainly aggravated by
exp: Removal of vegetation loosens soil, which slides down during heavy rain.

q: Which of the following is the first step in the disaster management cycle aimed at reducing the impact of a future disaster?
exp: Mitigation and preparedness precede response and recovery measures.

q: Which of the following is a renewable resource?
exp: Forests regenerate if managed sustainably, unlike fossil fuels.

q: Which of the following layers of the atmosphere contains most of the weather phenomena?
exp: The troposphere, the lowest layer, contains most water vapour, clouds and weather.

q: Fossil fuels such as coal and petroleum are formed from
options: Remains of ancient plants and animals buried and heated over millions of years
exp: Burial under heat and pressure converts organic remains into coal, oil and gas.

q: The movement 'Appiko' in the Western Ghats of Karnataka was aimed at
options: Saving trees from felling by embracing them
exp: Appiko (Kannada for hugging) was launched in 1983 in Uttara Kannada by Pandurang Hegde.

q: Which of the following is an example of a biotic component of an ecosystem?
exp: Biotic components are living organisms - producers, consumers and decomposers.

q: Decomposers such as fungi and bacteria play an important role in an ecosystem by
options: Recycling nutrients from dead organic matter
exp: Decomposers break down dead matter, returning mineral nutrients to the soil.
